verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Open WebUI connects to user-supplied providers (Ollama, OpenAI, Anthropic, and OpenAI-compatible APIs), which covers the bring-your-own-backend half. Nothing in the pack documents token usage or cost tracking per model or per conversation, which is the core of this story. Multi-provider connectivity is a separate capability and does not earn credit here.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation
